name: Operaismo
summary: Operaismo (workerism) is the heterodox Marxist current that arose in 1960s Italy and holds that working-class struggle, not capital's own laws, drives capitalist development. It analyses 'class composition', treats the wage and the refusal of work as political weapons, distrusts both the Communist Party and the unions as mediators, and looks to autonomous workers' organisation aiming at power for the working class and the abolition of the worker's condition.
scope: Classical operaismo of Quaderni Rossi, Classe Operaia and Potere Operaio (c. 1961-1973) built on Panzieri, Tronti, Alquati and early Negri, with the Autonomia Operaia and Wages-for-Housework offshoots used only where the sources link them to it. Excludes later academic post-operaismo (Empire, multitude) except as noted; most statements on social, religious, national and foreign-policy questions were never addressed, so those answers are low-confidence inferences from class-centred Marxism.

keyFigures.name: Mario Tronti
keyFigures.role: Leading theorist of Classe Operaia who formulated the reversal of Marx's viewpoint and the strategy of refusal.

keyFigures.name: Raniero Panzieri
keyFigures.role: Founder of Quaderni Rossi who criticised technology's neutrality and the party-class identity.

keyFigures.name: Antonio Negri
keyFigures.role: Leading theorist of Potere Operaio and later Autonomia.

missingStatements.text: Workers should refuse to work harder or longer as a political weapon, whatever the wage offered.
missingStatements.rationale: Refusal of work, absenteeism and sabotage as political acts, with 'more money, less work', is the movement's defining demand.
missingStatements.declined: Refusal of work is specific to the autonomist strand; alienated-labor and direct-action cover the adjacent ground.

missingStatements.text: Technology under capitalism is a means of controlling workers rather than a neutral tool.
missingStatements.rationale: Panzieri argued capitalist technology is a form of class domination, and Tronti that technological change follows class struggle.
missingStatements.declined: Narrow Marxist technology thesis; the bank is kept lean.

missingStatements.text: The labour movement's established parties and unions mainly manage workers' demands within capitalism instead of advancing them.
missingStatements.rationale: Operaisti viewed unions and the PCI as mediators who co-opted the Hot Autumn and kept workers inside capital's framework.

notes: Post-operaismo (Hardt and Negri) and the Wages for Housework current extend the tradition to unwaged and social labour; answers there rest on secondary descriptions. Many answers are inferences because operaismo did not address most social or foreign-policy questions.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Not a workerist demand as such; operaisti read welfare provision as a field of struggle over social wages, so they would back free care while distrusting state management of it.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Wage struggle is political for operaisti, but a legal minimum is a state-mediated bargain and they stressed workers' own pressure; support is inferred from egalitarian wage demands.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Markets and capital's command over production are what the workerists oppose; Tronti treats capital's organisation of production as the thing refused.

public-ownership.rationale: State ownership leaves workers under a boss; Tronti saw state planning as capital's control of the working class, so nationalisation is no goal in itself.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Not a core demand; inferred from hostility to capital, though redistribution through the state is seen as secondary to wage and power struggles.

unions-good.rationale: Operaisti held that union demands reflect capital's needs and that unions co-opted the Hot Autumn revolt, though workers' own organisations were valued.

property-fundamental.rationale: Tronti calls for all power to the workers against capital's command; private ownership of the means of production is the target of the whole analysis.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Regulation is state mediation within capitalism, which operaisti saw as capital's self-management; weak support at most as a tactical gain.

cut-welfare.rationale: Welfare and social wages were seen as gains won by struggle (self-reduction, social wage); cutting them is an attack on the class.

worker-ownership.rationale: Control from below by workers was Panzieri's aim, but operaisti stressed refusing work and power rather than ownership of firms; they favour it over capitalist or state ownership.

surveillance-ok.rationale: The movement was itself a target of state surveillance and the strategy of tension; they treat the state as an adversary.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Never a theme of the texts; inferred from the libertarian, anti-state counterculture of Autonomia.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Not addressed; distrust of state power and of state-defined limits on expression suggests mild disagreement.

strong-leader.rationale: Workerists located power in worker self-organisation and rejected leader or party substitution for the class.

state-harmful.rationale: Tronti calls the state a form capital needs to dominate society and regards it as part of capital's order, though the aim was workers' power rather than statelessness as such.

limit-guns.rationale: No documented position; movement has some militants who advocated arms while the mainstream stressed mass struggle.

empower-police-military.rationale: Tronti describes force as capital's reply to workers' refusal; the movement's sources treat police repression as state violence against workers.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Wages-for-housework currents debated sex work; operaisti proper did not take a settled line.

decide-locally.rationale: Local factory and neighbourhood autonomy mattered, but the strategy aimed at class power across the nation and beyond, so adherents are split.

rehabilitation.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from treating crime and repression as products of class order.

traditional-family.rationale: Operaisti-derived feminism (Wages for Housework) treated the family as a site of unpaid reproductive labour for capital.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Outside the concerns of the texts; neither marriage as an institution nor opposition to it is a documented position.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not discussed in the main texts; inferred from the left and feminist milieu that Autonomia shared in 1970s Italy.

more-religion-public.rationale: Secular Marxist tradition; religion not a workerist subject, so inferred.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Not a theme of classical operaismo, focused on the Italian industrial working class; no settled position.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Inferred from the feminist offshoot linking unpaid labour to patriarchy rather than nature.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Class not nation is the operaisti subject; preservation of tradition is not a concern, so mild disagreement inferred.

gradual-change.rationale: Tronti rejects reformism and the PCI line of gradual institutional reform; he demands power for workers.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The mass worker was largely southern migrants in northern factories; the movement saw them as protagonists, so restricting migration is rejected by inference.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Not discussed; international bodies are capitalist institutions in the workerist frame.

free-trade.rationale: Not addressed directly; opposition to capital's command over production implies no endorsement.

nation-first.rationale: The working class is the political subject across borders; national interest is an expression of capital's order.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Not addressed; anti-state, anti-imperialist stance suggests suspicion of state military action.

open-borders.rationale: Inferred from the focus on migrant workers and class internationalism, though not a stated programme.

limit-growth.rationale: Tronti treats capitalist development as driven by class struggle and aims at the worker's end of work, not at degrowth; no ecological framework.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Not a theme of classical operaismo, which preceded climate politics.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Panzieri argued technology is not neutral and that capitalist technology is a form of domination.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from Panzieri's critique of capitalist technology and the Italian left's mood.

revolution-justified.rationale: Tronti treats the working class as the only revolutionary process and demands all power for the workers.

experts-over-public.rationale: Panzieri saw technocratic rationality as despotism and called for total democracy from below; Alquati's co-research privileged workers' own knowledge.

central-planning.rationale: Tronti describes planning as political control over workers in economic guise, so central planning is not an answer.

socialized-markets.rationale: Markets as such are not their target but the wage relation is, so socialised markets would still be capitalist for them.

land-value-tax.rationale: Tax design on land rent is not discussed in the workerist sources and gives no basis for either side.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Not addressed; mildly supportive of anything hitting the property-owning class.

basic-income.rationale: Post-operaist currents (Negri, Hardt) endorse a guaranteed income as pay for social production; the classical wage-demand tradition supports 'more money, less work'.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: National protection of industry is an aim of capital, not of workers; no stated position.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Tronti views state planning as capital's instrument of control.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Aim is the abolition of the worker condition, not dispersal of small property.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: The movement aimed to abolish the condition of being a worker and the wage relation, though the wage was also fought for in the short run.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Not addressed; right-libertarian framing of leaving money to the market is alien to them.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised bodies setting wages are the kind of mediation Tronti rejects; the movement refused to bargain within a capitalist framework.

one-party-rule.rationale: Tronti and Panzieri criticised the identity of class and party and sought organisation from below; the PCI's party model was a target.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Hereditary rule is contrary to their class politics; inferred from Marxist, anti-state commitments.

democracy-best.rationale: Tronti calls the state a democratic phase of capital's class dictatorship, though Panzieri sought total democracy; both qualify liberal democracy sharply.

direct-votes.rationale: Panzieri's total democracy and workers' assemblies favour direct decision making, though the texts do not specify referendums.

workers-councils.rationale: Panzieri and Bologna drew on the council tradition, and Hot Autumn autonomous committees were the movement's chosen form of power.

right-to-secede.rationale: National questions fall outside the main texts.

natural-rulers.rationale: Marxist egalitarianism and trust in workers' collective capacity contradict natural-ruler ideas.

political-violence-never.rationale: Potere Operaio moved toward an armed insurrectional strategy, and Tronti sees violence as capital's reply rather than workers' initiative but not as illegitimate for workers.

war-builds-character.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from Marxist anti-militarism.

separate-church-state.rationale: Secular Marxist outlook assumed; not discussed.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Capital's private command over society is what they attack; a private security order would deepen it.

military-superiority.rationale: Rival states' armed competition is not a working-class aim; hostile to national militarism.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The class, not ethnicity, defines the political subject; the movement relied on migrant workers.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Tronti makes working-class struggle the driver of capitalist development itself, a reversal in which struggle comes first.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Equal raises for all in the Hot Autumn and the end of class distinctions imply egalitarian outcomes.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Indigenous claims lie outside a movement focused on Italian factory workers, so there is no documented position.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Not addressed; left anti-imperialism would incline to sympathy but there is no documented view.

civilizational-union.rationale: Class not civilization is the political basis; inferred.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Collective class interest is the moral axis; individual self-interest as virtue is a bourgeois idea in their framework.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Not discussed; collective class solidarity but also anti-statist, so mild disagreement.

limit-population.rationale: Not addressed; Marxist critique of population-control frames would incline against.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Operaisti saw industrial capitalism as domination, but they were centred on factory workers and sought to seize capacities, not return to the pre-industrial.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Panzieri warned technology is class domination, while later autonomist thinkers saw potential in technological change; split.

human-enhancement.rationale: Bodily enhancement is not discussed; Panzieri's warnings on capitalist technology and later autonomist hopes for technology pull in different directions.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Inferred from Panzieri's critique of technological rationality as despotism.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Inferred from the movement's experience of state surveillance and persecution.

restore-past-order.rationale: Workerism pushes forward against capital; Tronti urges revolution, not restoration.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The movement rested on a strong theoretical stance (class composition); pragmatism detached from class analysis is disfavoured.

direct-action.rationale: Wildcat strikes, sabotage, absenteeism, self-reduction and refusal were the central practice; Tronti said the class does not need institutions but needs organisation.

means-match-ends.rationale: Autonomy of workers from party and union points to prefigurative-style organisation, but the texts stress power rather than prefiguration.

return-to-foraging.rationale: The movement sought to abolish work-as-wage, not return to a primitive economy.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Workerism against work aims to abolish the condition of the worker and the capitalist organisation of labour.

distribute-by-need.rationale: The aim of 'more money, less work' and equal raises matches a communist distribution, though it is rarely spelled out.

production-for-use.rationale: Refusing capital's command of production implies production not governed by profit.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Tronti and Panzieri's Marxist analysis: capital depends on extracting surplus from the working class.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Tronti anticipates the organised working class becoming the ruling class and demands all power for workers, without specifying the state form.

collective-farming.rationale: Peasantry not addressed by a movement centred on industrial workers.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Marxist background; not a topic of their key texts.

taxation-theft.rationale: Anarcho-capitalist view is opposite to theirs; they do not treat taxation as theft.

harm-principle.rationale: Liberal formulation; not relevant to their texts, mild disagreement inferred.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Collective class subject; individual-rights liberalism is not their frame.

conscription.rationale: Hostile to state coercion and military discipline of workers; inferred.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Contrary to the collective struggle and workers' voice; inferred.

state-as-business.rationale: The state is capital's tool of domination, not a model to follow.

positive-liberty.rationale: Freedom from compulsion to work and material means is the point of refusal of work.

media-academia-power.rationale: Class power in capital and the state is their analysis; elected-officials-versus-media is not their frame.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Class is the unit; racial hereditarianism is antithetical to the Marxist egalitarian tradition.

organic-representation.rationale: Corporatist representation conflicts with autonomy against union and state mediation.

total-state.rationale: Tronti analyses state absorption of society as the capital's control, and Negri's social factory is a critique of it.

national-rebirth.rationale: Fascist-type narratives are opposed; the movement was antifascist.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Class internationalism and anti-imperialism oppose territorial expansion.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Feudal authority is the opposite of workers' self-organisation.

bound-labor.rationale: Compulsory bound labour is the extreme of what refusal of work opposes.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Panzieri held technology and science are not neutral, and Alquati's co-research treats knowledge as shaped by class position.

universal-morality.rationale: Marxist historical materialism is sceptical of universal reason, but the texts do not address it.

single-common-good.rationale: The movement's premise is irreconcilable class antagonism, so a single common good is rejected.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: The sources never take up Zionism, and a national-state right is outside the class framework, so this is left neutral.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Diaspora and homeland rights are not addressed in the sources, so no position can be inferred.

revive-national-language.rationale: Not addressed; national projects are outside class politics.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Panzieri's total democracy in forms rooted in the economic sphere favours worker control, though the aim goes beyond co-management.

school-vouchers.rationale: Not addressed; market provision in schooling disfavoured by inference.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: No documented view; deficit orthodoxy is a capital discipline.

economic-freedom.rationale: Economic freedom as capital's freedom is not a precondition of their political freedom.

rule-by-example.rationale: Not discussed; mass struggle rather than moral leaders.

national-self-determination.rationale: National questions secondary to class; adherents split.

force-without-un.rationale: Not discussed; opposition to state warfare.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Not directly relevant; secular Marxist but statement is epistemological.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The movement stressed migrant workers as protagonists and class over nation.

work-for-welfare.rationale: The refusal of work is the core strategy; compelling work for benefits is the opposite.

class-collaboration.rationale: Class antagonism is the premise and Tronti rejects bargaining within the capitalist framework.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Not addressed; futurist-style destruction of culture is not part of the texts.

dominated-front.rationale: Not addressed; class rather than nation as basis for fronts.

workers-nation.rationale: The working class is understood as an international class and one against national unity strategies of the PCI.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The Wages for Housework current attacked unpaid gendered roles.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Utterly alien to the egalitarian class politics of the movement.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Tronti describes the state as the democratic phase of capital's class dictatorship, and in Refusal says capital needs the state to dominate society.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Energy supply was not a theme of 1960s workerism; its factory focus gives no basis for a stance.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Migrant workers were seen as protagonists with their own composition and culture.

elite-replacement.rationale: A conspiracy theory outside any workerist framing; class analysis opposes it.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral systems were not their concern; parliamentary politics was a secondary arena.

national-mission.rationale: Opposes nationalism and exporting state forms.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Dalla Costa and Federici argue unwaged women's labour is essential to capitalist reproduction and linked to patriarchy.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Tronti and Panzieri attacked the labour-movement leadership and parties; 'corruption' as framing differs from structural critique.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Eugenics is alien to and opposed by their egalitarian politics.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Libcom guide documents state violence like Pinelli's death and the strategy of tension; accountability is inferred.

night-watchman-state.rationale: They see the state as capital's tool and want far more than property protection.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Opposed by the egalitarian internationalist politics.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Egalitarian by Marxist inference, though the texts speak in class terms.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Not a notable topic among operaisti who focused on Italian worker composition.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Settler colonialism is outside the Italian-factory focus of the sources, though Marxist anti-imperialism might lean sympathetic.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Religious personal-law questions are absent from the workerist sources and not derivable from class analysis.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: They criticised state strengthening and Soviet-type states; Tronti sees state forms as capital's control.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Tronti regards parliamentary legitimacy as mediation by capital but values workers' consent to their own organisation.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilist national aim not in their frame.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Tronti treats capital's command and the state's force as the ordinary violence of class rule, and the movement defended sabotage and wildcat action, so no absolute ban on force is accepted.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Class struggle, not competition between peoples, is their motor.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: The movement was itself repressed by the state; banning parties is a use of state power against them.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Resistance to capital's command over workers resembles this, though not framed in republican terms.

separated-powers.rationale: Tronti sees the democratic state as a form of capital's dictatorship; checks and balances are no priority.

vanguard-party.rationale: Tronti's class is prior to the party, and Panzieri rejected the identity of class and party; but he argues the class needs organisation, so not strongly.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Not the framing; the working class is the subject, inferred sympathy.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Not addressed; self-reduction campaigns covered rents instead.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Strikes are the central political weapon of the class.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Poverty is a result of capital's exploitation in their analysis.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Sortition was not proposed in the sources; Panzieri's democracy from below could favour it, but no text says so.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: The movement experienced emergency repression after 1979; inferred opposition.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Self-reduction of prices in Autonomia is the related practice; state price fixing is not documented.

party-controls-media.rationale: Panzieri's total democracy and anti-party-statism conflict; also they sought independent worker press.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Class autonomy over party; Panzieri criticised identity of class and party.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The EU was seen later as a capitalist order; not addressed in early texts.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Opposes concentrating military command in an executive.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is absent from the sources and unrelated to workerist concerns.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Standard Marxist-left internationalism, not specifically documented here.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Inferred from anti-NATO leftism; texts note Gladio.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Rent strikes occurred but not abolition of renting.

people-in-arms.rationale: Some militants favoured arms; the mainstream spoke of mass struggle.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: The movement was centred on industrial and urban masses.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: National reunification is a state-form question the class-centred sources never discuss.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Alquati's co-research relied on intellectuals working with workers.

death-penalty.rationale: Opposed in the left milieu and the state's repression was the target of their critique.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Not discussed in the main texts; support is inferred from the progressive, feminist-influenced left milieu around Autonomia.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Not discussed; the libertarian streak of Autonomia and feminist critiques of pornography would split adherents.

minority-language-support.rationale: Not discussed; mild support is inferred from egalitarian, anti-assimilationist solidarity with migrant workers.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Not discussed in the sources, and a class-first view gives no obvious answer on exemptions.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Not discussed for decolonisation, but Tronti's view that political forms serve the class order implies formal independence alone is insufficient.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Not addressed; parliamentary formal means secondary.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: The movement opposed capital's development at workers' expense.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Foreign aid is not discussed in the sources; aid could be seen as either solidarity or capital's tool.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Not discussed; national nuclear arsenals are state-military instruments the movement opposed, so disagreement is inferred.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Constitutional design of the presidency is absent; Tronti sees all state forms as capital's, giving no preference among them.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Not discussed; hostility to territorial nationalism suggests mild disagreement.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: They reject property outright rather than subordinate it.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Operaisti criticised the PCI's Soviet model; the state-capitalist reading is a common left-communist view, but not centrally documented.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environmental risk governance is absent from 1960s workerist sources.

collective-defense.rationale: Not discussed directly, but the sources describe NATO-linked Gladio as hostile, so alliance guarantees are opposed by inference.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Questions on annexation and occupation are not addressed in the sources.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Not discussed; the movement distrusted state power, so a stronger state over clergy gets only mild disagreement.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: A ceremonial head of state is of no concern to the class-power sources.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Not addressed; opposed to state force.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Special-autonomy arrangements for regions are not discussed in the sources, and class politics gives no clear answer.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Unthinkable in this secular Marxist current.

character-from-environment.rationale: Class composition emerges from social conditions and struggle.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Not discussed; the call for total democracy from below implies no ruler above the law.

space-expansion.rationale: Not discussed; a capital-driven space project is not a workers' aim, so mild disagreement is inferred.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical class balance is not their aim.

leader-cult.rationale: Panzieri and Tronti reject substitution of class by leader or party.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family-law presumptions are not covered by the sources.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Operaisti saw class conflict persisting in state-planned societies; inferred from Tronti on planning as control.

refugee-return.rationale: The right of return is a national-conflict issue absent from the sources.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Nationalist claim opposed by class internationalism.

women-must-cover.rationale: Inconsistent with feminist currents of the milieu.

common-currency.rationale: Monetary union is not discussed and could be read either as capital's project or as integration.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Not discussed; ancestry-based unions cut against class internationalism, so mild disagreement.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Minority-nation arrangements are not addressed in the sources.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: The sources do not discuss minority emigration versus struggle at home, though class struggle in place is the general approach.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Marxist base, but Tronti emphasises the political composition of struggle over structure; qualified agreement.

ban-cartels.rationale: Competition-restoring policy is not their goal.

no-bailouts.rationale: No stated position; hostility to capital but also to austerity on workers.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Tronti regards all democratic state forms as phases of capital's dictatorship, so he gives no support to either courts or majorities.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Quotas in public bodies are not covered; the feminist current focused on wages for housework instead.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Trade treaty clauses are not discussed in the sources.

moral-incentives.rationale: They demanded more money for less work and treated wages as a political weapon.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Potere Operaio moved toward an armed party, but the classic line holds that the working class composes revolution from struggle, not a small group.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Not discussed; class-centred internationalism suggests mild disagreement with civilization-centred curricula.

patriotic-education.rationale: Not discussed; class internationalism and the movement's hostility to national unity inform the inference.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Not discussed in the sources, and adherents' egalitarian and class-first leanings could pull either way.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary mechanics are absent, though post-operaist thinkers later discussed money.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Tronti's capital develops by restructuring in response to struggle, but crisis is seen as political; adherents mixed on collapse.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Not discussed; cultivating imperial legacy influence conflicts with anti-imperialism.

delink-world-market.rationale: Development strategy for poor countries is outside the sources.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: The mass worker was the centre of their analysis as exploited.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Constitutional entrenchment is not discussed; formal rights would be seen as part of the liberal state form.

elective-rulers.rationale: The sources do not take up the monarchy-election distinction.

minority-veto.rationale: Not discussed; unanimity rules conflict with collective class decision-making, so mild disagreement.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Not framed constitutionally, but refusal and resistance to rulers are central, so support is inferred.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Parliament is part of capitalist state order in Tronti's analysis.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Animal ethics is absent from the sources.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Animal ethics is absent from the sources.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Paternal charity from the privileged is the opposite of workers' own power.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Politics is class struggle for the workerists.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Tronti's view stresses class dictatorship and workers' mediation by unions and parties rather than cultural hegemony.

party-own-road.rationale: Operaisti broke with the PCI line and Moscow's model; left independent.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Development financing is outside the sources.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Not addressed, and the class-first approach gives no clear answer.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: The movement faced the strategy of tension and neofascist violence in Italy.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: The movement itself was communist; the equivalence thesis rejected by inference.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Not discussed; Marxist historiography generally treats slavery as the cause, so disagreement is inferred.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Not discussed; the movement's feminist current focused on women's unpaid labour.

military-guardian-role.rationale: The sources record the strategy of tension and army-state links as threats to the left, so a political army is opposed by inference.

paid-care-work.rationale: Dalla Costa and Federici in the Wages for Housework tradition argue unpaid domestic labour is capitalist labour that should be waged.

filial-duty.rationale: Not discussed; the critique of the family as unpaid reproductive labour suggests mild disagreement.

office-by-exam.rationale: Not addressed; technocratic meritocracy contrary to total democracy.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Strategic-industry ownership is not discussed, and workers' interest is not tied to national ownership.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Not discussed; support is inferred from the left and feminist milieu of Autonomia.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Panzieri's renewal from below and council forms imply delegates bound to their base.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Social wage and collective provision preferred; inferred.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Land tenure is not discussed in a movement centred on industrial workers.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Parliamentary budget control is a liberal-state concern the sources do not take up.

single-official-language.rationale: Not discussed; mild disagreement inferred from support for migrant workers and egalitarianism.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Not discussed; restricting foreigners cuts against class internationalism.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Not centrally addressed; the movement demanded more income.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: State sponsorship of insurgents is not discussed, and opposition to state force and to foreign state interests could cut either way.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Opposed to Soviet-style intervention; inferred from PCI critique.

corporate-influence.rationale: Capital's dominance of politics is their premise, though not framed as lobbying.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Not discussed; national-sovereignty restrictions fit poorly with class internationalism.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Not discussed; mild disagreement inferred from state family policy being alien to the movement.

residents-only-property.rationale: Not discussed; local restrictions on newcomers conflict with solidarity with migrant workers.

job-guarantee.rationale: The refusal of work contradicts guaranteeing work as an end.

democratic-peace.rationale: Not discussed; theory in international relations is outside the sources.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Strategy of refusal and wildcat action reject obedience to capital's order.

non-intervention.rationale: Not discussed, and anti-imperialist and internationalist leanings pull in opposite directions.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Conspiracy ideas opposed by class analysis.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Not discussed by the main texts, though the feminist current criticised the family as a labour site.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Not discussed; support is inferred from workers' inquiry and the opposition to state secrecy.

local-production.rationale: Not discussed; the movement's analysis centres on large mass-production factories.

informal-organisation.rationale: Tronti states the class needs organisation not institutions; Autonomia was a loose network, but classical operaisti founded journals and groups.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Not discussed; mild disagreement inferred from the class-internationalist orientation.

religious-nation.rationale: Not discussed, but class-based nationless politics opposes religious definition of the nation.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Not discussed; tributary hierarchy among states conflicts with the anti-imperial left outlook.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Fiscal federalism is not discussed in the sources.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Not discussed; marketised service provision runs against workerist anti-capitalism.

religion-illusion.rationale: Not discussed in the operaisti texts, but inherited Marxist critique of religion makes agreement likely.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Tronti held capital develops via workers' struggle, creating conditions for working-class power; Marxist heritage.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Wages for Housework argued unpaid women's labour is essential to capitalist reproduction.

socialized-care.rationale: Autonomist feminists demanded recognition of reproductive labour, with socialising it widely accepted in the milieu.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Not discussed; linguistic purism conflicts with the internationalist, migrant-worker outlook.

treaties-binding.rationale: Treaty rights of nations within states are not covered.

cooperative-communities.rationale: The movement centred on factory class power.

majority-settlement.rationale: Not discussed; state-encouraged ethnic settlement runs against class internationalism.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Not discussed; class politics gives no weight to historical territorial claims.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Not discussed, but the left counterculture milieu is opposed by inference.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Not discussed, but the secular, anti-statist outlook implies opposition.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Not discussed; Marxist anti-imperialism implies opposition to colonial extraction.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Not discussed, and religious-obligation claims lie outside the sources.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Not discussed; religious takfiri politics is alien to secular Marxism.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Panzieri called for total democracy from below rooted in the economic sphere; autonomous committees.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Class-first approach; feminists in the milieu added gender, but there was no unified line.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Not discussed in the sources, which predate such debates.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Left class partisanship is fundamental; Tronti insists on partisanship of the working class.

alienated-labor.rationale: Refusal of work and Panzieri's critique of capitalist technology rest on work under capital as domination and estrangement.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Not discussed, but class internationalism and solidarity with migrants imply rejection of civilizational essentialism.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Not discussed; secular Marxism and the claim that workers' power is the source of politics imply rejection.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Not discussed; support is inferred from the movement's hostility to employer power and the feminist current.

social-market-economy.rationale: Tronti's critique of welfare-state synthesis as control over the workers' movement applies.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Not discussed; hostility to the state's coercive forces coexists with some militants' view on workers' arms.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Not directly discussed; they criticised NATO-linked Gladio and the Soviet-aligned PCI, so adherents may be split.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Not discussed, though hereditary power conflicts with egalitarian worker control.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Credit systems are not discussed in the sources.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Not discussed; opposition to disciplines imposed on workers makes support likely.

property-franchise.rationale: Not discussed, but a property qualification conflicts with working-class power as the aim.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Ecofeminist claims are not discussed in the sources.

reification.rationale: Class-composition analysis and Panzieri see capitalist technology and planning appearing as objective rationality which hides domination.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Tronti proposes an independent working-class newspaper, implying the existing press serves capital.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Tronti treats state legality as a phase of capital's dictatorship, so he gives no weight to rule-of-law procedure.

racial-franchise.rationale: Not discussed, but incompatible with the egalitarian class politics of the movement.

online-participation.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from support for broad participation, though the sources predate the internet.

open-government-data.rationale: Not discussed; transparency fits workers' inquiry and total democracy.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Not discussed; legal restriction of marriage conflicts with the left, secular outlook.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Not discussed; scapegoating a minority conflicts with class solidarity.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Sortition assemblies are not discussed; Panzieri's democracy from below could favour them, but there is no text.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Capital's concentrated power is the premise, though phrased as class dominance.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Not addressed; the movement opposed militarism.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Not a stated position; the movement was hostile to the police but not documented as an abolitionist.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Consociational design is not covered in the sources.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Not discussed; paternal charity is incompatible with workers' own power and demands.

term-limits.rationale: Not discussed; electoral procedure was secondary to the movement's extra-parliamentary stance.

vote-delegation.rationale: Liquid democracy is not discussed in the sources.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Not discussed in sources of this period.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Not discussed; the feminist milieu would favour equal access.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Not discussed; the feminist current's critique of domestic hierarchy suggests support.

rent-control.rationale: Autonomia ran rent strikes and self-reduction campaigns against housing costs.

abolish-ip.rationale: Intellectual property is not discussed by classical operaisti, though post-operaists later wrote about knowledge commons.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Not discussed; drilled national youth movements are alien and fascist-associated, so opposition is inferred.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Not discussed; opposition is inferred from the movement's hostility to NATO structures.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Gladio and NATO's role noted; inferred.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Operaismo analyses wages and profit as extracted from workers' labour and treats capital's income as unearned appropriation, so rewarding useful work over ownership is central.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Operaismo accepts class violence and Potere Operaio did not renounce it, so absolute pacifism is rejected; inferred from its discussion of violence.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Inferred from its class-centred internationalism, which sets working-class composition above national history; not directly addressed.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: The Wages-for-Housework offshoot treated the sexual division of labour as made by capital, but the main current did not address whether sex itself is constructed.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Not addressed by the core current; the Wages-for-Housework strand questions the unity of the working class by gender but offers no stance on a category of women.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Inferred from its materialist class focus, which has no place for honouring national martyrs.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Operaismo is a materialist Marxist current that treats politics as class struggle, not a spiritual struggle.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Not addressed; the sources are silent on diasporas and homelands.

culture-before-state.rationale: Operaismo sees power as taken through working-class organisation, not cultural renewal, though it focuses on the state as capital's instrument rather than building one.

god-not-male.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; as a materialist Marxist current it has no position on religious language.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Not addressed beyond the Wages-for-Housework strand, which did not frame religion.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Inferred from its class internationalism, which rejects ordering economic life by national or ethnic group.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Inferred from its class internationalism and distrust of the state; territorial units by people are not addressed.

independent-unions.rationale: Operaismo wanted autonomous workers' organisation independent of the party and of unions acting as mediators for capital.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: The current's central aim is power for the working class itself, not for a party standing in for it.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Not a workerist theme; inferred from treating social services as a field of working-class struggle.

second-chamber.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from workerist preference for workers' autonomous organs over parliamentary forms.

municipal-property.rationale: Operaismo sought workers' control and abolition of the worker's condition, not community ownership; inferred.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Not addressed; the focus on factory and class organisation, not territorial confederations, makes this an inference.

family-wage.rationale: The strategy of refusal of work treats the wage as a weapon and rejects the family-wage ideal; inferred, and feminist offshoots attacked it.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Never addressed; no basis in the sources for a side.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Never addressed; no basis in the sources for a side.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Inferred from autonomist hostility to state control; payments were never addressed.

online-anonymity.rationale: Inferred from autonomous, anti-state organising; never addressed.

person-over-state.rationale: The refusal of work and abolition of the worker's condition reject using persons as mere instruments of production; inferred.

spiritual-nature.rationale: A materialist class-centred Marxism, so a spiritual nature is not a theme; inferred.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Territorial self-government was not addressed by the current.

gm-crops.rationale: Never addressed; no basis in the sources for a side.

dense-cities.rationale: Never addressed; no basis in the sources for a side.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Class-centred analysis rejects racial group interests as the organising basis; inferred.

racial-pride.rationale: Inferred from class-centred internationalism; never addressed.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Inferred from the Italian left's opposition to imperial and capitalist wars; never addressed directly.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Operaisti define the subject by class composition, not by language or nation; class solidarity cuts across national lines, though the point was never addressed. Inferred from class-centred Marxism.

communal-electorates.rationale: Operaismo treats religion and community as secondary to class and wants autonomous workers' organisation, so separate religious electorates would fragment the class. Inferred.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: The current frames conflict as class against capital rather than nation against foreign powers; such plots were not a workerist theme. Inferred.

free-public-college.rationale: Operaisti read social services as part of the social wage and a field of struggle, so free tuition fits their demands, though it was not specifically discussed. Inferred.

pollution-taxes.rationale: A pollution tax works through capital's own price mechanism, which operaisti distrust in favour of working-class pressure; they never addressed it. Inferred.

future-generations.rationale: Not a workerist theme, but a general egalitarian Marxist outlook would accept some duty to those who come after. Inferred, weak commitment.

women-distinct-values.rationale: The wages-for-housework offshoot stressed women's unpaid labour, not distinct feminine values, and adherents did not take a common line. Inferred.

arms-reduction.rationale: Operaisti opposed militarism as an instrument of capital and the state, so they would back cuts, though it was not central. Inferred.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Hostility to elite mediation and state secrecy suggests support for open diplomacy, but the question was never discussed. Inferred.

capital-controls.rationale: Operaisti saw capital's mobility as a weapon against workers, so limits on it fit, but they distrusted the state as controller. Inferred.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Operaisti distrusted the state and defended armed workers' self-defence in the 1970s Autonomia, so they would not accept a state monopoly on arms; inferred.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Workerism's rejection of capitalist state wars and class-first outlook support refusal, but the sources do not address soldiers directly.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Operaisti distrusted unions as mediators and favoured autonomous workers' struggle over negotiated agreements, while still demanding wage gains.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Workerism sought wage struggle and refusal of work, not state top-ups, and saw such supplements as tools of capitalist management; inferred.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Operaismo treats state economic management as a capitalist tool and would not support legal fiscal limits; inferred, low.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Operaismo's class-centred approach focuses on the working class in advanced capitalism; global redistribution toward developing countries is not discussed and is inferred from general left internationalism.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Operaismo viewed the state as an instrument of capital and sought autonomous workers' power rather than taking over the existing state apparatus.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Operaismo aimed at abolishing the worker's condition but left the economy's future form unspecified; the sources do not say.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Operaismo sees nature and labour alike as capital's raw material; counting nature as capital would be seen as extending capital's logic; inferred.

sacred-nation.rationale: Operaismo is a class-centred Marxist current hostile to nationalism, so a sacred nation conflicts with its principles; inferred.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Operaismo supports the working class's refusal of debt and wage discipline, but the issue is not addressed in the sources; inferred.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Early operaismo studied the North-South divide in Italy as a class composition question, but the sources do not frame it as colonialism.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Marxist historical materialism treats human nature as shaped by social relations and workerism seeks to abolish the worker's condition; inferred.

public-service-media.rationale: Operaisti saw mass media as a tool of capital and were distrustful of state institutions, so state-funded independent media is not a workerist demand; inferred.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Inferred from the materialist Marxism of the operaisti, who treat belief as a product of social relations; religion was not a topic.

farm-price-support.rationale: Inferred from the operaisti's focus on the industrial working class; state protection of farmers was not a workerist demand.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Inferred from the anti-militarist left of the 1960s-70s Italian movement; the question was not addressed.

workers-own-party.rationale: Inferred from Tronti's insistence on the autonomy of the working class from capital and from the established parties, including the PCI; adherents split on forming a new party.

ban-fgm.rationale: Inferred from the movement's offshoot Wages for Housework, which centred women's bodily and social autonomy; FGM was not addressed.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from the Wages-for-Housework offshoot's demands for women's economic independence; property rights were not discussed directly.

one-language-many-names.rationale: A linguistic classification question the class-centred movement never addressed.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Inferred from the strategy of refusal and collective workers' control, which rejects private-suit remedies within the legal order of capital.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred from the movement's rejection of hierarchy and authority; hereditary leaders in lawmaking were never addressed.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Inferred from the movement's rejection of authority and its focus on workers' liberation; limits justified by the environment were not addressed.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Inferred from the movement's hostility to state punishment as an instrument of class rule; not directly addressed.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Inferred from the internationalist class focus, which opposes compulsion against migrant workers; not directly addressed.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Operaisti distrusted unions as mediators but opposed measures that weaken workers' collective power; inferred and leaning against right-to-work framing as a bosses' device.

voter-id.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from workerist contempt for bourgeois electoral machinery and opposition to exclusionary rules.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from secular materialist Marxism, which treats religion as private and gives no doctrine privilege.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the Marxist view that formal elections leave capital's power intact, so procedure alone does not make a government democratic.

premarital-sex.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the 1960s-70s Italian left's rejection of traditional sexual morality.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Anachronistic; inferred from the workerist stress on autonomous worker organisation and communication against state control.

negative-income-tax.rationale: They demanded wages and income as political weapons, not a replacement of welfare by a shrinking cash payment; inferred from the wage-struggle stance.

women-suffrage.rationale: Not addressed directly; inferred from class-centred Marxism and the Wages-for-Housework offshoot's equal-rights outlook.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Offshoots located women's oppression in capital's unpaid domestic labour rather than religion; inferred.

race-social-construct.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the Marxist view that divisions among workers are produced by capital's rule.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Not addressed; adherents distrusted state mediation yet backed women's demands, so the stance is split.
